preconditions.description: The number of destinations n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of corridors m is between n-1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects two distinct valid destinations.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor's energy requirement e is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: No pair of destinations {a, b} appears more than once in the input.

preconditions.expression: is_connected(n, [(a, b) for a, b, e in corridors])
preconditions.description: The graph formed by the corridors is connected.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines, one for each input corridor.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= 10**9 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(is_max_energy_valid(n, corridors, i, int(output_lines[i])) for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: For each corridor i, the output value E_max(i) is the largest integer e <= 10^9 such that if the energy of corridor i is set to e, there exists a minimum spanning tree (MST) of the graph that includes corridor i.
